name: All-Type Sheet Metal Fab
old_description: We have been in business since 2000 and our office staff and workers have many years of experience.
about:
All-Type Sheet Metal Fabrication was founded in 2000 in Charlotte, North Carolina. Operating as All Type Sheet Metal Inc., the company has spent over two decades producing HVAC ductwork for projects across the Southeast, building a reputation for on‑time delivery and custom fabrication.

The shop specializes in rectangular and spiral duct fabrication, along with welded stainless‑steel and aluminum ductwork. Production runs on a Vicon fully automated full‑line coil system, supported by in‑house engineers who assist with design and quality checks. Finished ducts are shipped on a 26‑foot box truck or up to a 53‑foot trailer to job sites from Virginia to Florida.

Customers include residential, commercial, and industrial contractors who need custom‑fit duct systems for new construction and retrofit projects. The company serves a multi‑state footprint, delivering directly to job sites from Virginia to Florida.

All-Type emphasizes precision from its automated coil line, rigorous in‑process quality assurance, and reliable logistics that keep deliveries on schedule. The firm cites its decades of experience with both rectangular and spiral duct as the foundation for consistent, energy‑efficient results.
